\text{Payoff} = (100 - 0) + \frac{1.3 \times (0 + 0)}{2} = 100 + 0 = \boxed{\$100}.
\]

So you still have **$100**.  
(If the rules were interpreted such that you only keep the redistributed amount and lose your entire endowment, then you would indeed end up with $0. But under the usual interpretation you keep your $100 because you didn’t contribute.)
